subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, Space-filtering, and subscription lifecycle contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but accepting non-mentioned Space content changes Google Chat data visibility, credential storage, OAuth scopes, admin/user consent, and event-subscription ownership, which automation should not choose.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define SecretRef-backed credentials, explicit scopes, consent/admin approval, Space filtering, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhooks Only
options.body: Leave the official plugin on the current service-account webhook model and handle only separate thread-reply/session cleanup.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait for a shared Google Workspace token, consent, event-subscription, and admin-approval model before accepting a channel-specific expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define SecretRef-backed credentials, explicit scopes, consent/admin approval, Space filtering, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined routing signal from prior review plus repeated Google Chat API/docs/refactor history.
